xz._comment: IMPORTANT: xz 5.6.0 was released with a backdoor (CVE-2024-3094). This has been resolved. Be cautious before taking any xz upgrades given this past behavior. liblzma is licensed as 0BSD. Other parts of code have different licenses. But we only use liblzma.

debian.amd64_reuse_boundary: 79 identical binary versions; grep has an ARM64-only +b1 binary rebuild of the same 3.11-4 source. Not a separate AMD64 dpkg source inspection.
